Summary.en: Adds an interactive crop dialog for images before they are uploaded.
Summary.de: Fügt vor dem Hochladen einen interaktiven Zuschneide-Dialog für Bilder hinzu.
Summary.it: Aggiunge una finestra interattiva di ritaglio per le immagini prima del caricamento.

Parameter.Container: The CSS-Selector of the div that shall contain the Cropper-UI.
Parameter.Target: The CSS-Selector of the image element that will contain the cropped image after clicking the Updater.
Parameter.File: The CSS-Selector of the file input where to select the image to crop.
Parameter.Updater: The CSS-Selector specifying the button that, on click, will cause an update of the Target.
Parameter.AspectRatio: The optional cropper's aspect-ratio to retain (e.g. 16 / 9 or 4 / 3). Setting this value will make the cropper non-resizable.
Parameter.OutputWidth: The width in pixels for the canvas where the cropped area shall be reflected. If provided as a string the minimum value is 100. Defaults to 1000px.
Parameter.CSSCropperHandle: The CSS that shall be applied on each cropper-handle (defaults to background-color: darkorange).
